findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.ainsof.io" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_link, search_by_reference · Private data: score_my_video, deliver_score, get_upload_link, analyze_video, search_by_reference · Public sink: get_upload_link, feedback, search_music, search_by_reference, cue_sheet · Destructive: get_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_link, search_by_reference · Private data: score_my_video, deliver_score, get_upload_link, analyze_video, search_by_reference · Public sink: get_upload_link, feedback, search_music, search_by_reference, cue_sheet · Destructive: get_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
